protocol.pairedMatcher: Unchanged current 0.63 matcher, same version in both arms
protocol.exposure: Each model receives its frozen existing question exposure; identical question IDs in the two executor arms. No outcome-driven invitations. Research mapping/rule changes measured separately.
protocol.blindness: Grok receives profile facts and actual multiple-choice prompts only. Prior answers, outcome counts, career links, scoring rules, route and wage metadata are withheld. Occupation names naturally contained within an assessment item are retained.
protocol.unknowns: No unstated interest invented; unfamiliar means unknown, not rejection. Skills, caregiving duties, demographic and wellbeing characteristics do not establish enjoyment.
protocol.limits: AI response-executor agreement study; neither executor is a ground-truth student response. Fixed comprehensive exposure is not real survey completion.

seal.method: All final transcripts use direct question keys, per-question allowed codes and the same configured Grok model/low effort. Positional pilots excluded before outcome analysis. Every actual prompt and response verified. No outcome-based selection.

limits: Same current 0.63 matcher, same catalog, same frozen profile and question exposure in both arms. This comparison deliberately excludes research 0.76 rule changes.

Exploration candidates use the unchanged production explorationRows059 selector, including visible contrary answers. Partial-specific follow-ups are a separate category. Fixed question exposure isolates the answer executor; it does not simulate adaptive new invitations. Lifestyle, profile context, strengths and training preferences remain frozen.

Supported alternatives are supported options outside Top three across the full catalog. Sustaining options are supported careers with an assessed pay proxy covering the same budget; these sets overlap Top and alternatives.
Higher Grok coverage is not proof of better matching. Unknown-to-Yes answers and answer-executor generosity can increase counts. Neither synthetic executor is student ground truth.

The original 172 authored profiles use narrative evidence; 828 procedural and 1000 Grok-authored profiles also supply explicit frozen activity facts. Evidence density differs and is reported separately.

Both executors receive the same questions per model, not the same number across models. No outcome-driven invitations or answer repair. Holdout groups remain separate; original and Grok synthetic populations are not pooled.
